name: Who Can Withstand Chat-Audio Attacks
description: Evaluates robustness of large audio-language models to chat-audio adversarial attacks across diverse audio inputs.
evaluation_method: attack_success_rate (measured as reduction in correct responses / increase in targeted failures)
reputation: New, emerging benchmark (ACL Findings 2025) attracting interest in audio-language model robustness and adversarial-audio communities but not yet widely standardized.
notes: Adversarial nature and small/targeted evaluation sets may limit generalization; results sensitive to preprocessing/transcription backends and model training data (possible contamination). Metrics can saturate for different attack strengths; reproducibility requires exact attack parameters and audio pipelines.
